title: fix(plugin-list): resolve the inline locale map behind the record-detail overlay heading
body:
Part of #9373 `ListViewSchema.label` is an `I18nLabel` — a plain string **or** an inline locale map such as `{ en: 'Accounts', 'zh-CN': '客户' }`. The `detailTitle` computation handed the raw member into the interpolation options of `detail.recordDetailWithLabel`, so a map-valued label reached the interpolator as an object and the record-detail overlay heading rendered `[object Object] Detail`. That value is `NavigationOverlay`'s `title` prop, which objectui#3426 established is the visible heading of the record-detail drawer / modal / split / popover — so the corruption was on user-visible chrome, in every locale, on **both** interpolator legs. No compiler run could ever have named the site: `createSafeTranslation`'s options bag is declared as a record of `unknown`, which accepts the map without a diagnostic. Only an executed assertion holds it. ## The scope measurement the card asked for first The card handed over an open question — does the `displayLocale` binding reach the `detailTitle` site, or is that a different scope? Two heuristics had given answers the dispatcher would not trust. Measured with the TypeScript parser (`ts.createSourceFile` with parent pointers, walking the real scope chain rather than counting braces), over the file as it stands on the merge base: | probe | innermost scope chain | |---|---| | `const displayLocale = useDisplayLocale();` | `Block` → `ArrowFunction` → `SourceFile` | | `const detailTitle = schema.label` | `Block` → `ArrowFunction` → `SourceFile` | | `viewLabel: resolveInlineI18nLabel(schema.label, displayLocale)` | `ArrowFunction` → `ArrowFunction` (useCallback) → `ArrowFunction` → `SourceFile` | | `const ariaLabel = resolveInlineI18nLabel(schema.aria?.ariaLabel, displayLocale);` | `Block` → `ArrowFunction` → `SourceFile` | The binding and the defect site are in the **same block** — the component body of the arrow function passed to `React.forwardRef`, identical start and end offsets on both chains — and the binding is declared earlier in that block, so there is no temporal-dead-zone hazard either. **The fork resolved to the easy side: the binding reaches the site and the repair is one call.** The compiler agrees independently — `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list run type-check` passes, and an out-of-scope identifier there would be `TS2304`. Reported back to the dispatcher as a falsified premise: the heuristic that "reported one 3,600-line function for every probe" was **right**, not wrong. The enclosing function really is one ~3,738-line arrow function; it was discarded for looking implausible. ## The repair The label is resolved through `resolveI18nLabel` — the idiom this same file already uses on this same member for the view label, and on the nested `aria` bag — on this component's `displayLocale`. Resolved **before** the truthiness test, not inside the branch: `resolveI18nLabel` answers `undefined` for a map with no usable entry and `''` for an empty entry, and both have to fall through to the `objectName` branch the way a missing label always did. Every object is truthy, so a resolution placed inside the branch cannot do that — and the two fall-through cases in the pin are what tell the two shapes apart. ## The pin, RED on the pre-fix tree Red-first on both interpolator legs, both through the mounted overlay, never on a local variable. Leg 1 — the provider-less `interpolateFallback`, new file `ListView.overlayTitleInlineLocale-9373.test.tsx`. Run on the pre-fix tree: `Tests 4 failed | 1 passed (5)`, exit 1. The one pass is the string-label negative control, which is what makes the four failures a reading rather than a broken harness. The heading element it rendered: ```

[object Object] Detail

``` Leg 2 — the i18next interpolator, one case added to the existing `ListView.overlayTitleI18n.test.tsx`. Pre-fix: `Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)`, exit 1, heading `[object Object]详情` (and the sr-only overlay description `[object Object]详情 的记录详情浮层。` alongside it). Post-fix, the three overlay-title files together: `Test Files 3 passed (3) · Tests 15 passed (15)`, exit 0. ## Clause ② — `no`, measured rather than asserted - Mechanical floor: the added-line grep for `^+export` over the whole diff returns **0**. No added line anywhere in the diff contains `export`. - The published face itself was measured, not reasoned about. Two full builds of `@object-ui/plugin-list` from a clean `dist/`, one with the fix and one with `ListView.tsx` reverted to the merge base, each preceded by an on-disk proof that the intended source really changed (marker count 3 → 0 → 3, blob hashes compared against the `HEAD` blob, restore verified by an empty `git diff HEAD`, `trap ... EXIT INT TERM` on the mutation): - CONTROL — emitted JS **differs** across the legs (`index.js` and `index.umd.cjs` both change), so both builds really ran and the reading is live. - SUBJECT — all **8** emitted `.d.ts` files are **byte-identical** across the two legs. So nothing this diff touches is referenced by an exported signature, and the published `.d.ts` does not move. Clause ② stays `no`. ## Verification | check | verdict | |---|---| | `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/` | `Test Files 80 passed (80) · Tests 979 passed (979)`, exit 0 | | `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` + `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) | exit 0, after building the dependency closure | | `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/plugin-list^...` | `Tasks: 12 successful, 12 total`, exit 0 | | `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0 — the gate's own verdict, satisfied with a real `patch` bump, not an empty declaration | | `pnpm changeset:check` | exit 0 | | `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | `0 new citation(s)`, exit 0 | | `pnpm check:i18n-keys` / `check:i18n-drift` / `check:i18n-dead-keys` | exit 0 | | `pnpm check:changeset-claims` / `check:pending-changeset-literals` / `check:test-path-roots` | exit 0 | | `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` | exit 0, 7855 tracked text files scanned | | `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on all four paths | `NOT GOVERNED — 4 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s)` | | `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the three changed source files | 3 files linted, **0 errors**; 0 warnings inside the changed hunk (the 186 warnings on `ListView.tsx` are pre-existing and elsewhere in the file) | The eslint run is a declared narrowing, not the repo-wide run: `pnpm lint` is `turbo run lint` across every package and belongs to CI. The narrowing is safe to read because the root `eslint.config.js` configures no `project`, `parserOptions` or `projectService` — type-aware linting is off, so a diff in these three files cannot move the verdict on any file it did not touch. Heavy runs (both builds, the package suite, the type-check, the two parity builds) went through the shared serialisation lock. ## Acceptance notes — noticed, not fixed Per the card's fence, siblings are reported and not touched. - **No sibling of this class remains in `plugin-list`.** Every other `t()` option bag in the package carries a `defaultValue`, a count, a limit, or a string built from `objectName` / a format name — none forwards an author-written `I18nLabel`. The `objectName` branch right below the repaired one is one of those: it is a `string` member and is untouched. - **Unmeasured lead, different class.** `action-button.tsx` and `action-icon.tsx` in `@object-ui/components` both forward `label: schema.label` into the action payload the runner uses to title its param-collection dialog. That is a payload forward, not a `t()` sink, and whether `ActionSchema.label` admits an inline locale map was **not** measured here. Recorded as a lead for the triage seat, explicitly not as a finding. - `DetailView.tsx` in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` passes `schema.recordNavigation` indices into `detail.recordOf` — numbers, not labels. Not this class. Per the card, objectui#9092 is not reopened and its fence is not extended; the `t()` signature is untouched; no other `t()` call site is swept. `#9092` is not addressed here. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_012EpHzwH4wTy5sd7ibkD2yq)_
